info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be awake, to abandon sleep, to be watchful

examples: 'tataH prajAgarAYcakrurvAnarAH' (Bawwi॰14.61). avekzAM cakrire. praSabdaH pratyarTe. avekzA pratijAgara iti kozaH.
'upaSaye sTitirapi prajAgaro Bavati taTA ca BArate prayogaH- 'adya yudDe susaNkrudDo dIrGaM rAjYaH prajAgaram' (Salya॰27.21).
'agne tvaM su jAgfhi vayaM su mandizImahi' (vA0 saM0 4.14, tE0 saM0 6.1.4.30). suzWu nidrArahito BavetyarTaH.
'jyotiragrA uzasaH prati jAgarAsi' (aTarva0 14.2.31). prati jAgarAsi jAgfhi. anatyantasaMyogepi uzasa iti dvitIyAntam. pratiyoge vA dvitIyA drazwavyA. tadA pratiranupasargo Bavati.
'udbuDyasvAgne pratijAgfhi' (vA0 saM0 15.54). pratijAgfhi saMnikarze sanIqe jAgaritA Bava. jAgrastfn.
